title: Beacon Systems Rangers
body_html:
Summary

Acme Health team that owns the Vantage-dsl-lib library and the DevOps setup our pipelines build on.

Details

Owners of Vantage-dsl-lib and DevOps. A standing team in the department: they work with Nova Programme on pipeline compatibility, and were involved in Horizon Programme and Everest Programme (past).
